findings.description: Prior text asserted VS Code 'usually writes' a manually selected interpreter into .vscode/settings.json via python.defaultInterpreterPath. Verified false against current official VS Code Python documentation: that setting is a read-only fallback from the extension's perspective; the current Python Environments extension stores the assignment via python-envs.pythonProjects instead. Corrected in scripts/build_chapter_02.py (section 2.8) to describe the documented current mechanism and explicitly state that manual selection does not write python.defaultInterpreterPath.
findings.resolution: scripts/build_chapter_02.py section 2.8 rewritten to state that python.defaultInterpreterPath is a read-only fallback the extension never writes on manual selection, and to describe the current python-envs.pythonProjects mechanism instead; the debug callout at the end of the page now points to sys.executable rather than a specific settings.json path. Chapter 2 regenerated; verified against code.visualstudio.com/docs/python/environments.
